description: Source code for agent-related classes and parsers in a language modeling framework, including AgentExecutor, output parsers, and utility functions.

classes.name: AgentExecutorIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for executing agent steps asynchronously, managing intermediate steps, final outputs, and stream iteration.

classes.name: AgentExecutor
classes.description: Main class for executing agents with tools, managing iterations, error handling, and output processing.

classes.name: ExceptionTool
classes.description: Utility tool class used for handling exceptions within agent execution.

classes.name: ReActSingleInputOutputParser
classes.description: Parser for agent actions and final answers in a specific format, used in React-style agents.

classes.name: XMLAgentOutputParser
classes.description: Parser for XML formatted agent outputs, extracting tools or final answers.

classes.name: AgentMultiActionOutputParser
classes.description: Abstract base class for parsers handling multiple agent actions.

classes.name: ToolCallingAgentOutputParser
classes.description: Parser for chat model outputs that invoke tools via function calls.

classes.name: JsonOutputToolsParser
classes.description: Parser for JSON formatted tool call outputs, extracting tool call details.

methods.name: streamIterator
methods.description: Asynchronous generator to stream agent steps during execution.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Main method to run the agent loop, managing steps, tools, and output.

methods.name: _takeNextStep
methods.description: Performs a single step in the agent execution, handling planning and tool invocation.

methods.name: _return
methods.description: Finalizes the output, handling intermediate steps and callbacks.

methods.name: _getToolReturn
methods.description: Retrieves the tool output if returnDirect is specified.

methods.name: _returnStoppedResponse
methods.description: Generates a response when agent stops early due to iteration/time limits.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses agent output text into actions or final answer.

methods.name: getFormatInstructions
methods.description: Provides format instructions for agent output parsing.

methods.name: parseResult
methods.description: Parses chat model generations into tool actions or final output.
